description: Geosen Press International, in association with Thunderminds Association, provides hands-on technology education that integrates AutoCAD, Robotics and Coding for a smarter, more innovative Zimbabwe.

features.title: 📐 AutoCAD Design & Plan
features.desc: Develop 2D and 3D design skills, mechanical and engineering drawings, and real-world project models.

features.title: 🤖 Robotics Build & Bring to Life
features.desc: Assemble and integrate hardware, sensors and actuators while developing automated systems and solving practical problems.

features.title: 💻 Coding Think & Control
features.desc: Learn Python, C++ and embedded programming to interface with sensors and motors and build automation and AI-enabled solutions.

connection_description: AutoCAD provides the design, Robotics brings the design to life, and Coding provides the intelligence and control.
